_about: The site_type merge map of owner decision D25 ('merge the site_type vocabulary'), read by scripts/remediation/mechanical/site_type_merge.py and pinned there by sha256 (MAP_SHA256). Each alias is a canonical type that names the same thing as the curated compound type of its own category group (api/cardgame/constants.py _GROUP_DEFINITIONS); the curated import's own vocabulary is the compound form (pipeline/ingesters/ancient_nerds_original.py keeps the compound names). Both CANONICAL_TYPES and the globe colours stay as they are: only the data moves (output/remediation/final-2026-10-08/plans/fields.md item 8 and trap 10). 'decision' stays null until the map is decided (fields.md item 8: Opus high decides, plus an adversarial check); `wave` refuses an undecided map.

decision.check: per-alias review against pipeline/normalizers/site_type.py (CANONICAL_TYPES, _SYNONYMS), ancient-nerds-map/src/constants/colors.ts CATEGORY_TO_GROUP, src/seo/display.ts SITE_TYPE_LABELS and the live curated rows of every alias; reasons in output/remediation/final-2026-10-08/X14_SITE_TYPE_MAP.md; independent adversarial check (claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-24): 16 merges hold, Megalithic refuted and kept

Settlement.why: the compound type names a settlement; same group Settlements

Town.why: the compound type names a town; same group Settlements

Urban.why: an urban site is a city or town; same group Settlements

Villa.why: the compound type names a villa; same group Settlements

Fortress.why: the compound type names a fortress; same group Fortifications

Citadel.why: the compound type names a citadel; same group Fortifications

Gate.why: the compound type names a gate; same group Fortifications

Church.why: the compound type names a church; same group Religious

Necropolis.why: the compound type names a necropolis; same group Burial & Death

Cave.why: the curated cave type is 'Cave Structures' (title label 'Cave site'); same group Rock & Cave

Road.why: the compound type names a road (the site title already shows both as 'Ancient road'); same group Infrastructure

Mine.why: the compound type names a mine; same group Infrastructure

Quarry.why: the compound type names a quarry; same group Infrastructure

Theater.why: the American spelling of the same word (the site title already shows 'Theatre'); same group Monuments

City.why: the compound type names a city (its first term), the same rule as Town; same group Settlements (X14)

Castle.why: the compound type names a castle (its first term); same group Fortifications (X14)

not_merged.Village: kept (X14): a village is a kind of settlement, not a spelling or synonym of a term the compound names; Village is a filter value of its own
not_merged.Fort: fort is not fortress (pipeline/normalizers/site_type.py: 'Do NOT merge distinct types (castle != fort != fortress)')
not_merged.Bridge: another group: Bridge is Infrastructure, Gate/archway/bridge is Fortifications (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Aqueduct: another group: Aqueduct is Water & Ports, Reservoir/aqueduct/canal is Infrastructure (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Tomb: a tomb is not a tombs complex
not_merged.Temple: a temple is not a temple complex
not_merged.Museum: a scope question, not vocabulary (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Geological interest: a scope question, not vocabulary (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Natural feature: a scope question, not vocabulary (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Magnetic anomaly: a scope question, not vocabulary (fields.md item 8)
not_merged.Megalithic: kept (X14, adversarial check 2026-10-24): the Megalithic group's own generic word, shared by its four subtypes (stones, structures, statues, walls); the normaliser maps a single megalith to it, and its rows split between Megalithic stones (alignments such as Rinaghju) and Megalithic structures - a per-site question, not a spelling
